newsitem.title: POLAND: Rafako says flood damage at PLN 18.9 mln.
newsitem.headline: Rafako says flood damage at PLN 18.9 mln.

text.p: Preliminary estimates show that Polish industrial boilermaker Rafako SA, suspended from Warsaw bourse trade since July 11 due to flooding, incurred 18.9 million zlotys of flood damage, the firm said on Monday.
But Rafako said in a statement that it was not changing its 370-million-zloty sales forecast for this year.

"Despite the difficult conditions, sales in July reached 12.4 million zlotys....Management is not changing the planned amount of sales for this year...(and) a 16.2-million-zloty provision has been made for forecast flood losses," it said.
Rafako said the provision would decrease as insurer Warta made good on claims.
It said the preliminary loss report did not include losses which could arise from a temporary break in production and from the removal of flood damage.
